name: Oxypertine
summary: Oxypertine, sold under the brand name Oxypertine among others, is an antipsychotic medication of the pertine group which was previously used in the treatment of schizophrenia but is no longer marketed. It was also evaluated for the treatment of anxiety.

pharmacology.text: The drug shows high affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2 and dopamine D2 receptors (Ki = 8.6 nM and 30 nM, respectively). It antagonizes the behavioral effects of tryptamine, a serotonin receptor agonist, and apomorphine, a dopamine receptor agonist, in animals. Like reserpine and tetrabenazine, oxypertine depletes catecholamines, though not serotonin, possibly contributing to its antipsychotic effectiveness.

summaryZh: 奧昔哌汀（英語：Oxypertine）是一種治療精神分裂症的抗精神病藥。在化學上，它是吲哚的衍生物，也是哌嗪的衍生物。如同利血平和丁苯那嗪，奧昔哌汀消耗的是兒茶酚胺，而不是血清素，可能與其抗精神病的療效相關。
summaryZhHans: 奥昔哌汀（英语：Oxypertine）是一种治疗精神分裂症的抗精神病药。在化学上，它是吲哚的衍生物，也是哌嗪的衍生物。如同利血平和丁苯那嗪，奥昔哌汀消耗的是儿茶酚胺，而不是血清素，可能与其抗精神病的疗效相关。

sideEffects.en: Like other older antipsychotics it can cause stiffness, restlessness and tremor, along with drowsiness and dizziness on standing. Antipsychotics carry a rare risk of a severe reaction with fever and muscle rigidity.
sideEffects.zh: 與其他舊式抗精神病藥一樣，它可能造成肌肉僵硬、躁動不安與顫抖，並伴隨嗜睡與站起時頭暈。抗精神病藥有罕見但嚴重的反應風險，會出現發燒與肌肉僵硬。
sideEffects.zhHans: 与其他旧式抗精神病药一样，它可能造成肌肉僵硬、躁动不安与颤抖，并伴随嗜睡与站起时头晕。抗精神病药有罕见但严重的反应风险，会出现发烧与肌肉僵硬。

fact.en: Its structure contains an indole ring, the same ring found in serotonin, which sets it apart from most other antipsychotics of its era.
fact.zh: 它的結構含有吲哚環，與血清素相同的環，這使它與同時代大多數抗精神病藥有所不同。
fact.zhHans: 它的结构含有吲哚环，与血清素相同的环，这使它与同时代大多数抗精神病药有所不同。
